name: FanBar
summary: A free, open-source native macOS menu-bar app for monitoring temperatures and managing fan cooling.

compatibility.requirement: The Mac must expose readable fan data through AppleSMC.

install.note: Notarized builds are published on GitHub Releases.

features: Menu-bar CPU temperature and fan RPM, with six icon styles that spin with the fans
Per-fan RPM on a 0-to-max meter, and a CPU, GPU, memory, and disk load grid
CPU and GPU temperatures, plus SSD and battery where available, with a rolling ten-minute chart
Automatic cooling, fixed target RPM, and editable temperature-to-RPM curves
Silent, Balanced, Performance, and Extreme presets that can restore Automatic after 15 minutes, 30 minutes, or 1 hour
Curve temperature source selectable from CPU, GPU, or SSD
Optional high-temperature notifications at 60-105°C (90°C by default) with a selectable alert sound
CSV logging of temperatures, fan speeds, and control mode every 2-60 seconds
fanbar command-line tool for status, presets, fixed RPM, and Automatic, with JSON output, plus Raycast Script Commands (0.7.0 and later)
Desktop widget on macOS 14 and later, with system-scheduled refreshes

safety.authorization: Manual fan control requires explicit approval of FanBar's signed privileged helper.
safety.limits: Fan targets are clamped to the hardware-reported fan range.
safety.fallback: FanBar attempts to restore macOS automatic fan control when manual control ends, the app quits, the connection is lost, or the helper fails.
